name: Ryedol's Lucky Pick
summary: Ryedol’s Lucky Pick is a mining tool lost when Shadowforge dwarves attacked Hammertoe’s Digsite in the Badlands. Prospector Ryedol hopes to get it back.

sections.title: A Prospector’s Tool
sections.body: Prospector Ryedol works south of Hammertoe’s Digsite in the Badlands. The Shadowforge clan attacked the excavation site and killed nearly everyone there, including Ryedol’s boss, Hammertoe. Ryedol escaped, but his lucky pick was left behind. He asks you to search among the Dark Iron dwarves for the tool.

faq.answer: Prospector Ryedol owns the pick and wants it returned.
The pick was left at Hammertoe’s Digsite in the Badlands after the Shadowforge clan attacked.
One of the Shadowforge dwarves at Hammertoe’s Digsite has the pick.

faq.q: Why does Ryedol want the pick back?
faq.answer: It is Ryedol’s lucky pick, and he asks you to recover it from the Shadowforge dwarves.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can help Prospector Ryedol recover his tool after the Shadowforge attack on Hammertoe’s Digsite.
